_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/units/潮汐禁卫兵种设计.md（2026-10-12 箭矢 10／17、招募费 1200／维持费 300 版）；name 取 loc land_units_onscreen_name，desc／story 取 loc unit_description_short_texts／unit_description_historical_texts（中英原文）。

role.zh: 精英混合远程步兵 · T3

desc.zh: 玉海舰队的魔法战士无人可当，没几个人能在潮汐禁卫的刀锋下全身而退。
desc.en: None can withstand the Tide Guard; few who face these magical warriors of the Jade Sea live to tell of it.

story.zh: 据说第一批潮汐禁卫的魔法与射击技艺由月后亲自传授，禁卫也因此立下只从女子中遴选的旧例。入选者多为水师中箭法出众的女兵，由禁卫统领统一锻炼长柄刀与弓的技艺。潮汐禁卫是震旦提督的贴身保镖，她们所使用的武器附着水魔法，水流缠绕其外，波涛暗藏其中。
story.en: It is said that the Moon Empress herself taught the first Tide Guard their arts of magic and marksmanship, and from that gift dates the old rule that the corps recruits only from among women. Most are the fleet's finest archers, drilled by the Guard Commander in the disciplines of the long-hafted blade and the bow. The Tide Guard are the personal bodyguard of the Cathayan admiral, and the weapons they bear are imbued with water magic: water coils about the steel, and within it sleeps the fury of the waves.

v.zh: 步兵 · 混合（近战＋远程）
长柄刀（魔法近战，反大）＋和弓（魔法箭）
v.en: Glaive (magical melee, anti-large) and Nipponese longbow (magical arrows)

v.zh: 舰队统帅厅（4 级）／玉海旗舰厅（5 级），游牧主城建筑链
v.en: Fleet Command Hall (tier 4) / Jade Sea Flagship Hall (5), in the main horde building chain
Upgrading to the Fleet Command Hall

k.zh: 远程武器威力（基础／破甲）

desc.zh: 长柄刀近战对大型目标 +18
desc.en: The glaive gains +18 against large targets in melee

desc.zh: 近战与远程均以破甲为主
desc.en: Mostly armour-piercing damage, in melee and at range alike

desc.zh: 可在远程射击与近战之间切换
desc.en: Can switch between shooting and melee

desc.zh: 作为阴相单位参与阴阳宁和
desc.en: Counts as a Yin unit for Battle Harmony

wh3_main_unit_passive_battle_harmony_yin.zh: 阴阳宁和生效时：速度 +4%、领导力 +4、装填技能 +12
wh3_main_unit_passive_battle_harmony_yin.en: While in Battle Harmony: speed +4%, leadership +4, reload skill +12
